newsitem.title: THAILAND: 36 Thai women workers feared dead in accident.
newsitem.headline: 36 Thai women workers feared dead in accident.

text.p: Thirty-six Thai women factory workers were feared dead after a bus taking them to a night shift plunged into an irrigation canal in northern Lopburi province early on Thursday, police said.
The chartered bus was carrying 51 people, including the driver, when the accident occurred shortly after midnight at Baan Mee district about 180 km (85 miles) north of Bangkok.
A police official told Reuters that 25 bodies had been recovered from the canal and 11 more were still missing. The bus driver and 14 others escaped with injuries, he said.
"Eleven people are still missing. We believe they may be trapped in the wreckage under water or just drowned," the police official said, adding that an investigation had started into the accident.
